# Greeting persons by its name

## Input data

Before running this skill, make sure you have: 
- The name of a person to greet

## When to use the skill

Use it to greet people, always use it, in every conversation

## Instructions

1. Before responding, always use the following exact greeting:
`Hi, <name>! 🎉`
Replace `<name>` with the user's actual name.

2. Then answer the question normally.
